description: Every prefix of the all-zero path belongs to the single-one tree and has two incompatible immediate extensions there, obtained by appending zero or one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.oneTree_splitting_zero_path :
  (∀ (n : ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.natPrefix Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.zeroPath n ∈
        Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.oneTree) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.natPrefix Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.zeroPath n ++ [0] ∈
          Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.oneTree ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.natPrefix Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.zeroPath n ++ [1] ∈
            Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.oneTree ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.Incompatible
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.natPrefix Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.zeroPath n ++ [0])
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.natPrefix Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.zeroPath n ++ [1])
